p: A certain orchard [bustana] was adjacent to the wall of a mansion [apadna]. … the outer wall of the mansion, … collapsed.

A certain orchard [bustana] was adjacent to the wall of a mansion [apadna]. The orchard was larger than two beit se’a and was enclosed for the purpose of residence by a wall, part of which was the wall of the mansion. One day the outer wall of the mansion, which also served as a wall for the orchard, collapsed.
Rav Beivai thought to say … we can rely upon

p: Rav Pappi said to him: Because you come from truncated [mula’ei] people, … you speak truncated [mulayata] matters,

Rav Pappi said to him: Because you come from truncated [mula’ei] people, as Rav Beivai’s family traced their lineage to the house of Eli, all of whose descendants were destined to be short-lived (see i Samuel 2:31), you speak truncated [mulayata] matters,
these walls were made for the inside
they were not made for the outside;
